description: Public edition: Combines astronomical data and physical models to reconstruct the evolution of large-scale cosmic structure.
body:
Cosmological Structure Reconstruction System. Combines astronomical data and physical models to reconstruct the evolution of large-scale cosmic structure.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 75 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Cosmic-Scale Technology". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Cosmic reconstruction is real science (BAO, weak lensing); system-scale integration is emerging.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Cosmological Structure Reconstruction System - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Combines astronomical data and physical models to reconstruct the evolution of large-scale cosmic structure.
body:
Known science foundations of Cosmological Structure Reconstruction System.

DESI, Euclid, and Rubin map structure; Bayesian reconstruction (BORG) infers initial conditions. The system integrates data and models into evolving reconstructions.

Key quantity check (Galaxies mapped in millions / galaxies in observable universe in billions): computed ratio 0.2 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Cosmological Structure Reconstruction System - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Combines astronomical data and physical models to reconstruct the evolution of large-scale cosmic structure.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Cosmological Structure Reconstruction System.

Systematics limit precision. Dark sector unknowns propagate. Reconstructions are model-dependent.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 10.6 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is total vs reconstruction resolution at 10.6 orders of magnitude (total larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

body:
Unresolved problems for Cosmological Structure Reconstruction System, in priority order (research burden index 25, 2 blocking):

Dark sector (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Model dependence (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Systematics (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
